output.answer: Yes. Most recently, Walmart confirmed small-scale role eliminations in its Optical field-support organization; its spokesperson characterized them as normal-course-of-business restructuring and did not disclose a number. Earlier, in May 2026, Walmart confirmed that some corporate roles would be eliminated amid a digital-operations reorganization, while contemporaneous reporting put the affected corporate jobs at about 1,000; Walmart also announced about 1,500 job cuts in a May 2025 restructuring.
caveats: The latest Optical announcement does not state how many people were affected, and Walmart framed it as small-scale restructuring rather than a company-wide layoff.
The approximately 1,000 figure for May 2026 came from contemporaneous reporting/source familiar with the matter; Walmart’s own confirmation said only that some roles were eliminated.
These announcements concern particular corporate, technology, support, training and Optical roles—not evidence that Walmart announced a broad, company-wide reduction across its store workforce.
